row.original_cell_incompatibility: The frozen C227853 road/depart_parked/curb cell initializes the actor on a highway curbside shoulder. The separate statutory entry movement starts outside a highway and crosses its legal boundary. Moving the start off-highway would cease to be a depart_parked/curb scene; treating the shoulder-to-lane merge as entering the highway would misstate the source fact.
row.binding_reason: C177626 is an existing paved_road/enter_road/other_vehicle motor_vehicle_driver cell. Its NRS-484B-260 witness explicitly uses a private-way origin and paved-highway entry; the same physical origin/boundary arrangement can test the separate NRS-484B-410 safety-before-entry obligation without changing either law or treating shoulder departure as entry.

law.title: Starting parked vehicle
law.text: A person, except when stopping, standing or parking where no parking is permitted, shall not start a vehicle which is stopped, standing or parked on a highway nor enter upon a highway unless and until such movement can be made with safety.

activation_conditions: the subject is stopped, standing or parked on a highway and starts, or enters a highway
the place is not one where parking is prohibited
exceptions: a person stopping, standing or parking where no parking is permitted is outside the rule
residue: tier S: 'with safety' is the whole obligation; the gap bound is a surrogate
summary.subject: driver

timing_requirements.requirement: 'unless and until' — the safety condition must hold before the movement begins, not be established by it
judged over the pull-out, until the subject is in the traffic stream

summary.title: Starting parked vehicle

source_observation_terms.note: the vehicle is stopped, standing or parked
the highway started onto or entered
operationalizes 'can be made with safety' for the lane entered
a user forced to brake by the start
'where no parking is permitted' — the carve-out for a vehicle that must move

minimum_case_design.comparison: hold C177626 paved-road entry geometry, private-way origin, highway boundary, ego policy and cameras fixed; vary approaching highway traffic position or arrival timing
source_obligations: cited off-highway private-way source and legal boundary
cited public-highway dedication, access and near/far boundary source
original ego footprints and timing before, at and after first highway-boundary crossing
original approaching highway traffic trajectories, surface gaps and braking observations
independent safety judgment made before movement and recorded review without numerical legal cutoff
minimum_case_design.judgment: measure movement and conflict evidence; do not encode a numeric legal safety cutoff
